# Shared test vectors, read by the Python and the C tests.
# valid <message> <seq> <hex of 32 bytes>   decodes and re-encodes to the same bytes
# invalid <error> <hex of 32 bytes>         decode must fail with that error (magic, crc, version, length, padding)
